art_note: The product imagery relies on basic flat lays and composited model shots, lacking the refined lighting and atmosphere of a true luxury fashion campaign.
desc_en: An essential piece crafted with precision. This thong merges a minimalist cut with a delicate white lace trim. Designed with a lightweight and elastic blend to ensure optimal comfort and an adaptable fit. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una prenda esencial confeccionada con precisión. Esta tanga combina un diseño de corte minimalista con un delicado ribete de encaje blanco. Confeccionada con una mezcla ligera y elástica para asegurar una comodidad óptima y un ajuste adaptable. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· 95% polyester and 5% spandex

· Made to order
